# Species Critical Habitat PBFs

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(officer)

# 1. Get the data
# Using [[1]] is safest if there is only one table, 
# or use params$data_list[["Combined Species List"]] if named.
df <- params$data_list[[1]]

# Safety check: If df is NULL, stop and print a message instead of crashing
if (is.null(df)) {
  cat("No data was found in the provided list.")
} else {

  # 2. DATA TRANSFORMATION
  formatted_df <- df %>%
    # Ensure Categories are handled
    mutate(PBF_category = ifelse(is.na(PBF_category), "", PBF_category)) %>%
    
    # STAGE 1: Group by Species and Category
    group_by(Species_full, PBF_category) %>%
    summarise(
      # The unique() here is what stops the PBFs and Categories from repeating
      pbf_list = paste0("  • ", unique(PBF), collapse = "\n"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    
    # STAGE 2: Combine categories into the final block
    mutate(
      category_block = if_else(PBF_category == "", 
                               pbf_list, 
                               paste0(PBF_category, ":\n", pbf_list))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Species_full) %>%
    summarise(
      PBF_Final_List = paste(category_block, collapse = "\n\n"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # 3. Create the flextable
  ft <- flextable(formatted_df)

  # 4. Formatting
  ft <- theme_vanilla(ft)
  ft <- width(ft, j = 1, width = 1.5)
  ft <- width(ft, j = 2, width = 5.0)

  # Set Headers
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, 
      Species_full = "Species (ESU/DPS)", 
      PBF_Final_List = "Physical or Biological Features"
  )

  # Align text to top
  ft <- valign(ft, valign = "top", part = "all")

  # Add borders between species
  ft <- border_inner_h(ft, border = fp_border(color="gray80", width = 1))

  # 5. Display
  ft
}
